title: Independent product probability measure
statement: For a finite set $\Omega$, a probability mass function $\pi$ on $\Omega$, and a natural number $n$, the independent product probability mass function on $\Omega^n$ has marginal distribution $\pi$ at each coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
